notes.title: Patch Notes V0.1.2
notes.notes:
[h1]We've released another alpha update! 
[/h1]
[h2]🚀 Here's what's new in v0.1.2:
[/h2]
[list][*] Made usernames clickable to open settings menu
[*] Tweaked slider sensitivity
[*] Fixed initiative menu bug where entities sometimes didn't appear[/list]
We greatly appreciate the continued support and especially the feedback you have all been giving us as we work to make Realm Architect even greater. Dive back into your realms and let us know what you think!

Be sure to join our Discord community to share your opinions and chat to other alpha testers. 
We regularly put polls in our Discord to shape future updates, so don’t miss the chance to be a part of it! 💬

[h2]Have something to share?
[/h2]
We would like to remind you that you can still share your opinion on the alpha version by filling in our feedback form. This way you do not only help us improve on bugs or frustrations currently encountered when using RA, but we can also better understand what you would like to see in the future of RA!

You can find the feedback form on our Kickstarter, or in your mailbox!

[i]Backers with alpha access can also use the form to get the Alpha Tester role in our Discord server. All you need to do is fill in your username at the end!
[/i]
[h1]Happy crafting, architects! 
The Realm Architect Team[/h1]

notes.title: Patch Notes V0.1.1
notes.notes:
[b][h1]We're updating our Realm[/h1][/b]

After four weeks of intense alpha testing, we're absolutely thrilled to announce the launch of our first alpha update, Version 0.1.1! 🚀

Thanks to your invaluable feedback, our developers have been hard at work addressing bugs and implementing quality-of-life features. In version 0.1.1, get ready for smoother playability with fixes for 8 bugs and the addition of 7 awesome QOL features. With these fixes we aim to improve your experience of the alpha's playability.🛠️

Here's a breakdown of the bugs we've fixed and the quality-of-life improvements we've made based on your input:

[h2]Bugs Fixed:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Text boxes no longer go offscreen, ensuring a seamless user experience.
[*] Multiselect issue when scaling a window has been resolved.
[*] Realm name and description no longer overlap in the menu, making navigation smoother.
[*] Character tokens can now be deleted as intended.
[*] The character list no longer goes offscreen, improving accessibility.
[*] Corrected initiative menu number input issues for accurate tracking.
[*] Map markers are no longer movable or editable in campaign mode.
[*] Fixed marker snapping issues for precise map placement.
[/list]
[h2]Quality-of-Life Features Added:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Enabled map list in campaign mode for better organization and navigation.
[*] Added more fields to characters, such as health, for enhanced customization.
[*] Expanded fields for codex entities in general, including damage for weapons, for richer storytelling.
[*] Made entity markers resizable for greater flexibility.
[*] Enhanced slider functionality for a more intuitive user experience.
[*] Renamed and moved the X button to close the application to a menu for smoother navigation.
[*] Added a settings menu with options for windowed view and toggling multi-display support.
[/list]
We're incredibly grateful for your continued support and feedback as we work to make Realm Architect the ultimate worldbuilding platform! We invite all alpha testers to dive back into their realm building and let us know how your enjoying the new update.
